| `ability:ABIL_CACOPHONY` | "current" | {"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"Cacophony"} | {"chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音","description_key":"Cacophony ability","english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. | `ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH` | "current" | {"english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath"} | {"chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息","description_key":"Caustic Breath ability","english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath","identity":"ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH, \"Caustic Breath\", 0, 0, 0, 3, {fail_basis::xl, 30, 1}, abflag::drac_charges }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `keep` | "名称与说明准确" |

| `ability:ABIL_DIG` | "current" | {"english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. | `ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION` | "current" | {"english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation"} | {"chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形","description_key":"End Transformation ability","english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation","identity":"ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION, \"End Transformation\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::none }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `keep` | "名称与说明准确" |
| `ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE` | "current" | {"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle"} | {"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃","description_key":"Enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_ENKINDLE, \"Enkindle\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::instant }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `adjust` | "统一法力与法术威力术语" |

| `ability_description:aphotic marionette ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Grabs hold of another creature's shadow and rapidly unleashes their spells and\nabilities as if they were your own, aimed at random enemies. You are also fully protected\nfrom any damage they would cause.\n\nCan only be used on creatures with eligible spells that they could productively\ncast at the moment. The process also leaves the victim's shadow too dim to grasp\na second time - once used successfully on a target, it may never be used on them\nagain.\n\n(Not all spells can be cast via this method; those which cannot will be marked\nwith an exclamation mark when examined.)","english_source_name":"aphotic marionette ability"} | {"chinese_description":"抓住另一个生物的影子，并快速释放它们的法术和能力，如同你自己的一般，\n瞄准随机的敌人。它们以这种方式召唤的生物将属于你，许多它们本应施加于\n自身的增益效果将转而施加于你。你也不会受到它们造成的任何伤害。\n\n只能对拥有在当前时刻可以有效施放的合适法术的生物使用。\n这个过程还会使受害者的影子变得太暗而无法再次抓取——\n一旦对目标成功使用，就再也不能对其使用。\n\n（并非所有法术都能通过这种方法施放；无法施放的法术在检视时\n将以感叹号标记。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"抓住另一个生物的影子，并快速释放它们的法术和能力，如同你自己的一般，\n瞄准随机的敌人。它们以这种方式召唤的生物将属于你，许多它们本应施加于\n自身的增益效果将转而施加于你。你也不会受到它们造成的任何伤害。\n\n只能对拥有在当前时刻可以有效施放的合适法术的生物使用。\n这个过程还会使受害者的影子变得太暗而无法再次抓取——\n一旦对目标成功使用，就再也不能对其使用。\n\n（并非所有法术都能通过这种方法施放；无法施放的法术在检视时\n将以感叹号标记。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"aphotic marionette ability","english_description":"Grabs hold of another creature's shadow and rapidly unleashes their spells and\nabilities as if they were your own, aimed at random enemies. | `ability_description:bind soul ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal\nservice. If the targeted monster is slain before it leaves your sight, it will\nreturn as a bound soul, retaining the equipment, spells and abilities it had in\nlife.\n\nOnly beings who are relatively uninjured may be targeted, and the focus required\nto keep their soul from escaping will consume 1/3 of the user's current health -\nreturning it only upon slaying them. The attempt will fail entirely if the\ntargeted monster leaves your sight before the process is complete.\n\nThe bound soul's health is influenced by the user's Invocations skill. It will\nfollow its captor through stairs, and can be recalled from other levels.\n\nOnly one soul can be bound at a time.","english_source_name":"bind soul ability"} | {"chinese_description":"试图将一个活物、神圣或恶魔生物的灵魂束缚为你的永恒奴仆。如果目标怪物在离开你\n视线之前被杀死，它将作为缚魂返回，保留生前拥有的装备、法术和能力。\n\n只能选择未受伤或仅受轻伤的生物作为目标，维持其灵魂不逃脱所需的专注会消耗使用者\n当前生命值的1/3——杀死目标后才会归还。若目标怪物在过程完成前离开你的视线，\n尝试将彻底失败。\n\n缚魂的生命值受使用者的祈神技能影响。它将跟随其捕获者穿过楼梯，并能从其他楼层\n召回。一次只能束缚住一个灵魂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"试图将一个活物、神圣或恶魔生物的灵魂束缚为你的永恒奴仆。如果目标怪物在离开你\n视线之前被杀死，它将作为缚魂返回，保留生前拥有的装备、法术和能力。\n\n只能选择未受伤或仅受轻伤的生物作为目标，维持其灵魂不逃脱所需的专注会消耗使用者\n当前生命值的1/3——杀死目标后才会归还。若目标怪物在过程完成前离开你的视线，\n尝试将彻底失败。\n\n缚魂的生命值受使用者的祈神技能影响。它将跟随其捕获者穿过楼梯，并能从其他楼层\n召回。一次只能束缚住一个灵魂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"bind soul ability","english_description":"Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal\nservice. If the targeted monster is slain before it leaves your sight, it will\nreturn as a bound soul, retaining the equipment, spells and abilities it had in\nlife.\n\nOnly beings who are relatively uninjured may be targeted, and the focus required\nto keep their soul from escaping will consume 1/3 of the user's current health -\nreturning it only upon slaying them. The attempt will fail entirely if the\ntargeted monster leaves your sight before the process is complete.\n\nThe bound soul's health is influenced by the user's Invocations skill. | `ability_description:cacophony ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. | `ability_description:enkindle ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"enkindle ability"} | {"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"enkindle ability","identity":"ability_description:enkindle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: EN ability description and ZH body agree on mechanics, targets and numbers; placeholders/Lua blocks preserved; terminology follows the glossary. When it\ncollides with a creature or other obstruction, it will detonate in a violent\nexplosion of {{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"fire or lava\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"cold or ice\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"negative energy or devastation\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"acid or metal splinters\"\n    else\n        return \"hellish energy\"\n    end\n}} whose radius depends on the distance travelled.\n\nYou are protected from this explosion yourself.","english_source_name":"globe of annihilation ability","identity":"ability_description:globe of annihilation ability","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/ability.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: EN ability description and ZH body agree on mechanics, targets and numbers; placeholders/Lua blocks preserved; terminology follows the glossary. | `ability_description:heal other ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Heals a creature other than yourself by a moderate amount, depending on\nInvocations skill. Using this ability on hostile monsters will try to turn them\nneutral. This works best on living creatures, with the undead and demons being\nprogressively harder to pacify. Intelligent creatures are also more difficult\nto pacify.\n\nGhosts of dead adventurers and demon lords are too wrathful to be pacified,\nmindless creatures are too unintelligent to be pacified, and no monster can be\npacified while it is asleep.\n\nWhether the pacification succeeds or not, the invested piety and magic points\nare lost. If it does succeed, the monster is healed and you gain the monster's\nfull experience value. Otherwise, the monster is unaffected and you gain\nnothing.","english_source_name":"heal other ability"} | {"chinese_description":"根据祈神技能，治疗好一个你以外的目标生物的一些创伤。\n对敌对怪物使用此能力将尝试使其变为中立。\n此能力对活物最有效；亡灵更难安抚，恶魔则比亡灵更难安抚。智慧生物也更难以安抚。\n\n死去的冒险者的鬼魂和恶魔领主因太过愤怒而无法被安抚；\n没有心智的生物因缺乏智力而无法被安抚；正在沉睡的怪物也无法被安抚。\n\n不管安抚成功与否，付出的虔诚值和法力都会失去。\n如果成功，那么怪物会被治愈，并且你会获得怪物全部经验值。\n否则，怪物不受到影响，你却一无所获。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"} | {"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"根据祈神技能，治疗好一个你以外的目标生物的一些创伤。\n对敌对怪物使用此能力将尝试使其变为中立。\n此能力对活物最有效；亡灵更难安抚，恶魔则比亡灵更难安抚。智慧生物也更难以安抚。\n\n死去的冒险者的鬼魂和恶魔领主因太过愤怒而无法被安抚；\n没有心智的生物因缺乏智力而无法被安抚；正在沉睡的怪物也无法被安抚。\n\n不管安抚成功与否，付出的虔诚值和法力都会失去。\n如果成功，那么怪物会被治愈，并且你会获得怪物全部经验值。\n否则，怪物不受到影响，你却一无所获。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"heal other ability","english_description":"Heals a creature other than yourself by a moderate amount, depending on\nInvocations skill. | `ability_description:hurl torchlight ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Hurls a gout of umbral fire from the Black Torch, which deals irresistible\ndamage to living, demonic, and holy beings. | `ability_description:imbue servitor ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Chooses one of the caster's destructive spells to grant to Spellspark Servitors\nthey create in the future, replacing any spell granted to them previously. | `ability_description:infernal servant ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Beckons a demon from the far reaches of Hell and binds it into service with your\nblood. | `ability_description:light the black torch ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Raises the Black Torch aloft and calls upon Yredelemnul to light it aflame,\nmarking the beginning of your attempt to conquer the current level of the\ndungeon. | `ability_description:recruit apostle ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Anoints a defeated apostle, and welcomes them as a permanent follower. | `ability_description:vessel of slaughter ability` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Invokes a blood pact with the Destroyer, temporarily granting you enormous power\nat a dangerous price.\n\nAt the moment the pact is sealed, a massive explosion of damnation will surround\nyou, and you will transform into a demonic avatar, granting you demonic\nresistances, invulnerable will, doubled healing from kills, and reducing all\ndamage you take by 1/3. | `mutation_description:airstrike attack mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you strike an enemy in melee, the wind twists around and strikes them\nfor additional damage which is increased for each empty space adjacent to them.","english_source_name":"airstrike attack mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你在近战中命中敌人时，风就会扭转并袭击它，造成额外伤害；\n与该敌人相邻的空位越多，额外伤害就越高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你在近战中命中敌人时，风就会扭转并袭击它，造成额外伤害；\n与该敌人相邻的空位越多，额外伤害就越高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"airstrike attack mutation","english_description":"Whenever you strike an enemy in melee, the wind twists around and strikes them\nfor additional damage which is increased for each empty space adjacent to them.","english_source_name":"airstrike attack mutation","identity":"mutation_description:airstrike attack mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:blade parry mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack\n(with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).","english_source_name":"blade parry mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你发动近战攻击时，你会短暂获得等同于杀戮加成的盾牌强度，\n并获得一项基于变形术技能的固定额外加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你发动近战攻击时，你会短暂获得等同于杀戮加成的盾牌强度，\n并获得一项基于变形术技能的固定额外加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"blade parry mutation","english_description":"You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack\n(with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).","english_source_name":"blade parry mutation","identity":"mutation_description:blade parry mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |
| `mutation_description:bloodcurse mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When you kill a living monster with a stab attack, they may rise again to serve\nyou as a vampiric thrall. | `mutation_description:demonic touch mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your hands glow with unholy energy, allowing you to inflict irresistible damage\nwhen launching melee attacks as long as your off-hand is free. | `mutation_description:drunken brawling mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you drink a potion that restores health or magic, you perform an\nimmediate attack against all enemies adjacent to you.\n\n(This includes potions of curing, heal wounds, magic, and ambrosia.)","english_source_name":"drunken brawling mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"当你喝下恢复健康或法力的药水时，你会立即攻击附近的所有敌人。\n\n（这包括治疗、愈伤、法力和琼浆药水。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你喝下恢复健康或法力的药水时，你会立即攻击附近的所有敌人。\n\n（这包括治疗、愈伤、法力和琼浆药水。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"drunken brawling mutation","english_description":"Whenever you drink a potion that restores health or magic, you perform an\nimmediate attack against all enemies adjacent to you.\n\n(This includes potions of curing, heal wounds, magic, and ambrosia.)","english_source_name":"drunken brawling mutation","identity":"mutation_description:drunken brawling mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:eeljolt mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge\nelectricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they\nfriend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"eeljolt mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 40% 时，电鳗会猛烈放电，以其正常电击伤害的两倍\n打击你周围 2 格内所有相连的目标——无论敌友。\n\n此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 40% 时，电鳗会猛烈放电，以其正常电击伤害的两倍\n打击你周围 2 格内所有相连的目标——无论敌友。\n\n此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"eeljolt mutation","english_description":"When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge\nelectricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they\nfriend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.","english_source_name":"eeljolt mutation","identity":"mutation_description:eeljolt mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:formless mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting\nobjects. | `mutation_description:foul shadow mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your body is shadowed by foul flame. Foes hit you less often, and your stealth\nis greatly enhanced. | `mutation_description:hive swarm mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less, angry bees will swarm\nout of your body to defend you.\n\nThis effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.","english_source_name":"hive swarm mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或更低时，愤怒的蜜蜂就会从你体内蜂拥而出，保护你。\n\n在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或更低时，愤怒的蜜蜂就会从你体内蜂拥而出，保护你。\n\n在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"hive swarm mutation","english_description":"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less, angry bees will swarm\nout of your body to defend you.\n\nThis effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.","english_source_name":"hive swarm mutation","identity":"mutation_description:hive swarm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep (finding resolved, both languages now aligned with the implementation): the initial review flagged that the ZH body omitted the numeric trigger and said only 受到严重伤害, while ouch.cc::_maybe_hive_swarm returns early when hp * 2 > hp_max, i.e. it triggers at 50% or less. The frozen #211 EN correction (less than 50% -> 50% or less) had been missed by the stable backport, so at that time the EN text, the ZH text and the code disagreed (EN < vs implementation <=). Both sides have now been read back from the current files: mutations.txt says \"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less\" and mutations.txt (zh) says 每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或以下时 with the 在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发 retrigger sentence. Threshold and retrigger condition now match the code, so the Needs Fix is closed." |

adjacent to a random enemy instead of\nnear you. When they appear, they do so in a blast of your characteristic\nDestruction (which cannot hurt you or other allies).\n\n(Your servants unleash blasts of either\n{{\n    if you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Dis destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"acid or metal splinters\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Tartarus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"negative energy or devastation\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Gehenna destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"fire or lava\"\n    elseif you.get_base_mutation_level(\"Cocytus destruction\") == 1 then\n        return \"cold or ice\"\n    end\n}}.)","english_source_name":"mark of carnage mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of carnage mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |
| `mutation_description:mark of execution mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill\nan enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a\nmaelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack\nwhenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy\nattack.\n\nYou have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if\nyou spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the\ndemonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.","english_source_name":"mark of execution mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of execution mutation","english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. | `mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |
| `mutation_description:mark of the celebrant mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. You will fire at\nleast one arrow for every valid target, but may fire additional ones if few are\npresent. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will\nalways bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them.\n\nAfter performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has\nfully recovered.","english_source_name":"mark of the celebrant mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至最大生命值的50%以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至最大生命值的50%以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the celebrant mutation","english_description":"Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. | `mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the fanatic mutation","english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |
| `mutation_description:mark of the legion mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Infernal Legion, allowing you to\ncall in a small army of demons over time. While individually short-lived, their\nnumbers are inexhaustible for as long as the status lasts, and they will never\nbe hostile to you.\n\nYou may also unleash Makhleb's Destruction through your summoned allies without\nharming them.","english_source_name":"mark of the legion mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的地狱仆从能力被替换为地狱军团，允许你随时间召唤一小支恶魔军队。\n虽然个体存活短暂，但只要状态持续，它们的数量无穷无尽，\n并且永远不会对你敌对。\n\n你也可以通过你召唤的盟友释放马科列布的毁灭而不伤害它们。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的地狱仆从能力被替换为地狱军团，允许你随时间召唤一小支恶魔军队。\n虽然个体存活短暂，但只要状态持续，它们的数量无穷无尽，\n并且永远不会对你敌对。\n\n你也可以通过你召唤的盟友释放马科列布的毁灭而不伤害它们。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the legion mutation","english_description":"Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Infernal Legion, allowing you to\ncall in a small army of demons over time. | `mutation_description:mnemnophage mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You devour the memories and even the very existence of those you kill, subsuming\nthem in the unholy fire that wreathes your body.\n\nOnce you have accumulated enough memories, you may choose to burn them all away\nas fuel to greatly enhance your spellcasting for a short period of time.\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"mnemnophage mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你吞噬被你杀死者的记忆乃至存在本身，将其融入环绕身体的不洁火焰。\n\n积累足够记忆后，你可以选择将其全部燃烧为燃料，短时间内大幅增强施法能力。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，你最多能储存足以连续施放\n{{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术的记忆。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你吞噬被你杀死者的记忆乃至存在本身，将其融入环绕身体的不洁火焰。\n\n积累足够记忆后，你可以选择将其全部燃烧为燃料，短时间内大幅增强施法能力。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，你最多能储存足以连续施放\n{{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术的记忆。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mnemnophage mutation","english_description":"You devour the memories and even the very existence of those you kill, subsuming\nthem in the unholy fire that wreathes your body.\n\nOnce you have accumulated enough memories, you may choose to burn them all away\nas fuel to greatly enhance your spellcasting for a short period of time.\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"mnemnophage mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mnemnophage mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:mortality bane` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"When you are badly injured and alone, a reaper may come to claim you. | `mutation_description:multi-lived mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Every third experience level, you gain an extra life. | `mutation_description:multiplicity bane` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Enemies in sight of you have a small chance each turn to create multiple clones\nof themselves. | `mutation_description:mutation resistance mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your genetic code is unusually stable, making it less likely that you will be\nmutated (or have existing mutations removed). | `mutation_description:naga tail mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You have a long, snake-like tail in place of feet. This gives you stability in\nwater, but causes you to move much more slowly than most species.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to constrict foes with your tail\nwhen attacking in melee. Your tail can constrict only one enemy at a time, and\nevery attack at this mutation level will begin or renew a constriction attempt.\nThe chances of succeeding are determined primarily by Dexterity, Fighting skill,\nand any slaying bonuses.","english_source_name":"naga tail mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的脚变成一条长长的蛇状尾巴，使你能在水中保持稳定，\n但移动速度会比大多数物种慢得多。这个变异达到第二级，\n你在近战时可以用尾巴束缚敌人。你的尾巴一次只能束缚一个敌人，\n在这个变异等级，每次攻击都会尝试开始或再次进行束缚。\n成功率主要取决于敏捷、格斗技能和任何杀戮加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的脚变成一条长长的蛇状尾巴，使你能在水中保持稳定，\n但移动速度会比大多数物种慢得多。这个变异达到第二级，\n你在近战时可以用尾巴束缚敌人。你的尾巴一次只能束缚一个敌人，\n在这个变异等级，每次攻击都会尝试开始或再次进行束缚。\n成功率主要取决于敏捷、格斗技能和任何杀戮加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"naga tail mutation","english_description":"You have a long, snake-like tail in place of feet. This gives you stability in\nwater, but causes you to move much more slowly than most species.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to constrict foes with your tail\nwhen attacking in melee. | `mutation_description:no regeneration mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the\neffects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. Sources of HP gain\nsuch as potions and religious invocations will still heal you, and certain\ndivine invocations can temporarily grant you the ability to regenerate.\nTo compensate, you are able to heal yourself via the\n<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> key, at the cost of permanent MP.","english_source_name":"no regeneration mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你在休息时无法恢复健康，也无法获得提升恢复速度的魔法效果。\n至于提升生命力的手段，像药水和虔诚的祈祷仍能治疗你，\n某些神圣祈祷能力可以短暂赋予你自愈的能力。\n作为补偿，你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 键治疗自己，\n但代价是要永久地失去一些法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你在休息时无法恢复健康，也无法获得提升恢复速度的魔法效果。\n至于提升生命力的手段，像药水和虔诚的祈祷仍能治疗你，\n某些神圣祈祷能力可以短暂赋予你自愈的能力。\n作为补偿，你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 键治疗自己，\n但代价是要永久地失去一些法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"no regeneration mutation","english_description":"You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the\neffects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. | `mutation_description:off-hand wielding mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a\ntwo-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. You will follow up attacks from\nyour primary weapon with your off-hand weapon, with attack delay determined\nby the average of the two. Ranged weapons can only follow attacks by ranged\nweapons, and likewise melee weapons.","english_source_name":"off-hand wielding mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"只要没有持握双手武器，也没有装备盾牌或魔法球，你就可以在副手持握一件单手武器。\n主手攻击后会追加一次副手攻击，攻击延迟由两件武器的平均值决定。\n远程武器只能追击远程武器的攻击，近战武器也同样只能追击近战攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"只要没有持握双手武器，也没有装备盾牌或魔法球，你就可以在副手持握一件单手武器。\n主手攻击后会追加一次副手攻击，攻击延迟由两件武器的平均值决定。\n远程武器只能追击远程武器的攻击，近战武器也同样只能追击近战攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"off-hand wielding mutation","english_description":"You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a\ntwo-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. Ranged weapons can only follow attacks by ranged\nweapons, and likewise melee weapons.","english_source_name":"off-hand wielding mutation","identity":"mutation_description:off-hand wielding mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:paradox bane` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you first spot a monster, it has a chance to become Touched by Paradox,\ngiving it the ability to use Manifold Assault as a natural ability (and a small\nchance to blink randomly after doing so).","english_source_name":"paradox bane"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你首次发现一个怪物时，它有概率被悖论触碰，\n从而能将多重攻击作为天生能力使用，并在使用后有小概率随机闪烁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你首次发现一个怪物时，它有概率被悖论触碰，\n从而能将多重攻击作为天生能力使用，并在使用后有小概率随机闪烁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"paradox bane","english_description":"Whenever you first spot a monster, it has a chance to become Touched by Paradox,\ngiving it the ability to use Manifold Assault as a natural ability (and a small\nchance to blink randomly after doing so).","english_source_name":"paradox bane","identity":"mutation_description:paradox bane","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:potion fungus mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your body is covered in a fungus that metabolises beneficial potions you drink\nand sometimes emits spores which transmit their effects to nearby monsters -\nwhether friend or foe.","english_source_name":"potion fungus mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的身体覆盖着一种真菌，它会代谢你喝下的有益药水，并有时释放孢子，\n将这些药水的效果传给附近的怪物——无论敌友。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的身体覆盖着一种真菌，它会代谢你喝下的有益药水，并有时释放孢子，\n将这些药水的效果传给附近的怪物——无论敌友。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"potion fungus mutation","english_description":"Your body is covered in a fungus that metabolises beneficial potions you drink\nand sometimes emits spores which transmit their effects to nearby monsters -\nwhether friend or foe.","english_source_name":"potion fungus mutation","identity":"mutation_description:potion fungus mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:spatial entanglement mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled\nalong to your new location. | `mutation_description:tentacles mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow\nor deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in\nmelee. Each tentacle can wear a ring, but you need four of them to move around,\nand either two or four tentacles to hold a weapon depending on its size, and\ntwo tentacles to hold a shield.\n\nYour tentacles will try to constrict foes which you attack in melee. (You cannot\nconstrict monsters larger than you.) Independently, you have a two-thirds chance\nof launching a damaging 'squeeze' attack whenever you attack in melee.","english_source_name":"tentacles mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的胶状身体有八个触手，可以帮助你在浅水或深水中移动，并能在近战时束缚敌人。\n每只触手都可以戴上戒指，但你需要四只触手用来移动，根据武器的大小，\n两只或四只触手可以拿一把武器，两只触手可以拿一面盾牌。\n\n当你近战时，你的触手会尝试束缚敌人。（你无法束缚比你大的怪物。）\n顺便一提，每当你近战攻击时，你有三分之二的机会发动破坏性的“挤压”攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的胶状身体有八个触手，可以帮助你在浅水或深水中移动，并能在近战时束缚敌人。\n每只触手都可以戴上戒指，但你需要四只触手用来移动，根据武器的大小，\n两只或四只触手可以拿一把武器，两只触手可以拿一面盾牌。\n\n当你近战时，你的触手会尝试束缚敌人。（你无法束缚比你大的怪物。）\n顺便一提，每当你近战攻击时，你有三分之二的机会发动破坏性的“挤压”攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"tentacles mutation","english_description":"Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow\nor deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in\nmelee. Each tentacle can wear a ring, but you need four of them to move around,\nand either two or four tentacles to hold a weapon depending on its size, and\ntwo tentacles to hold a shield.\n\nYour tentacles will try to constrict foes which you attack in melee. Independently, you have a two-thirds chance\nof launching a damaging 'squeeze' attack whenever you attack in melee.","english_source_name":"tentacles mutation","identity":"mutation_description:tentacles mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:time-warped blood mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your blood has desynchronised itself from the flow of time. | `mutation_description:trickster mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread\nmisfortune.\n\nWhenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby\nenemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. This bonus improves\nwith the number of different enemies affected, but will decay over time if you\ndo not continue to inflict new misfortune.\n\nAt your current XL, you can gain a maximum bonus of\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} AC this way.","english_source_name":"trickster mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你散播不幸时，与生者领域的联系会变强。\n\n每当你或盟友对附近敌人施加新的负面状态（中毒除外）时，你的护甲等级会暂时提高。\n受影响的不同敌人越多，加成越高；若不继续施加新的不幸，加成会随时间衰减。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，此方式最多可获得\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} 点护甲等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你散播不幸时，与生者领域的联系会变强。\n\n每当你或盟友对附近敌人施加新的负面状态（中毒除外）时，你的护甲等级会暂时提高。\n受影响的不同敌人越多，加成越高；若不继续施加新的不幸，加成会随时间衰减。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，此方式最多可获得\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} 点护甲等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"trickster mutation","english_description":"Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread\nmisfortune.\n\nWhenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby\nenemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. This bonus improves\nwith the number of different enemies affected, but will decay over time if you\ndo not continue to inflict new misfortune.\n\nAt your current XL, you can gain a maximum bonus of\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} AC this way.","english_source_name":"trickster mutation","identity":"mutation_description:trickster mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:water reaching mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you\nto reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary\nattacks of all sorts.\n\nThe precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're\nadjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you,\nregardless of where you strike.","english_source_name":"water reaching mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"你的身体由能灵活变形的元素水构成，可以从数格外发动近战攻击，\n包括各种辅助攻击。\n\n偷袭所需的精确动作仍只能在与目标相邻时完成；无论从哪里攻击，\n斧头也只能顺劈到与你相邻的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的身体由能灵活变形的元素水构成，可以从数格外发动近战攻击，\n包括各种辅助攻击。\n\n偷袭所需的精确动作仍只能在与目标相邻时完成；无论从哪里攻击，\n斧头也只能顺劈到与你相邻的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"water reaching mutation","english_description":"Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you\nto reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary\nattacks of all sorts.\n\nThe precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're\nadjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you,\nregardless of where you strike.","english_source_name":"water reaching mutation","identity":"mutation_description:water reaching mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

| `mutation_description:werefury mutation` | "static-body" | {"english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation"} | {"chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"} | {"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"werefury mutation","english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation","identity":"mutation_description:werefury mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"} | `keep` | "keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found." |

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"使你能在松软岩石和生锈栅栏中挖出通道。激活此能力本身没有消耗，\n只会让你做好挖掘准备；激活后，向墙壁移动就会开始打通通道。\n挖掘会制造一些噪音，并降低使用者的生命上限。\n\n激活后，再次激活此能力或进行任何非挖掘的移动动作都会取消挖掘状态。","current_chinese_name":"挖掘"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle"},"fact_sha256":"b7fcc998a9e58476fe709c043b497386c1af4926bf942a9306177eb26fc56a3f","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃","description_key":"Enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_ENKINDLE, \"Enkindle\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::instant }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"统一法力与法术威力术语","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"选择施法者的一个破坏性法术赋予其未来创造的法术火花仆从，\n替换之前赋予它们的任何法术。施法者必须能够以不超过20%的失败率\n自己施放此法术。\n\n注意：以这种方式赋予法术将花费数回合，并且如果仆从处于活动状态，\n也会将其解散。","current_chinese_name":"灌注仆从"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Chooses one of the caster's destructive spells to grant to Spellspark Servitors\nthey create in the future, replacing any spell granted to them previously. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","current_chinese_name":"烙印武器"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"Imprint Weapon"},"fact_sha256":"19b1b82b81c882024385cf39835ebc52ad92fbc721de75464b785a40f090b09e","identity":"ability:ABIL_IMPRINT_WEAPON","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","current_chinese_name":"烙印武器","description_key":"Imprint Weapon ability","english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"Imprint Weapon","identity":"ability:ABIL_IMPRINT_WEAPON","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_IMPRINT_WEAPON, \"Imprint Weapon\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::delay }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"消除 one 的指代歧义","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"抓住另一个生物的影子，并快速释放它们的法术和能力，如同你自己的一般，\n瞄准随机的敌人。它们以这种方式召唤的生物将属于你，许多它们本应施加于\n自身的增益效果将转而施加于你。你也不会受到它们造成的任何伤害。\n\n只能对拥有在当前时刻可以有效施放的合适法术的生物使用。\n这个过程还会使受害者的影子变得太暗而无法再次抓取——\n一旦对目标成功使用，就再也不能对其使用。\n\n（并非所有法术都能通过这种方法施放；无法施放的法术在检视时\n将以感叹号标记。）","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Grabs hold of another creature's shadow and rapidly unleashes their spells and\nabilities as if they were your own, aimed at random enemies. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"试图将一个活物、神圣或恶魔生物的灵魂束缚为你的永恒奴仆。如果目标怪物在离开你\n视线之前被杀死，它将作为缚魂返回，保留生前拥有的装备、法术和能力。\n\n只能选择未受伤或仅受轻伤的生物作为目标，维持其灵魂不逃脱所需的专注会消耗使用者\n当前生命值的1/3——杀死目标后才会归还。若目标怪物在过程完成前离开你的视线，\n尝试将彻底失败。\n\n缚魂的生命值受使用者的祈神技能影响。它将跟随其捕获者穿过楼梯，并能从其他楼层\n召回。一次只能束缚住一个灵魂。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal\nservice. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"enkindle ability"},"fact_sha256":"5923ea56a098a30faa67cabdbea6c745c1f4f2c0a376720978d97e648940a4e4","identity":"ability_description:enkindle ability","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"ability_description","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在点燃状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在点燃状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt","description_key":"enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"根据祈神技能，治疗好一个你以外的目标生物的一些创伤。\n对敌对怪物使用此能力将尝试使其变为中立。\n此能力对活物最有效；亡灵更难安抚，恶魔则比亡灵更难安抚。智慧生物也更难以安抚。\n\n死去的冒险者的鬼魂和恶魔领主因太过愤怒而无法被安抚；\n没有心智的生物因缺乏智力而无法被安抚；正在沉睡的怪物也无法被安抚。\n\n不管安抚成功与否，付出的虔诚值和法力都会失去。\n如果成功，那么怪物会被治愈，并且你会获得怪物全部经验值。\n否则，怪物不受到影响，你却一无所获。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Heals a creature other than yourself by a moderate amount, depending on\nInvocations skill. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"高举黑火炬并呼唤伊莱德莱姆努尔将其点燃，标志着你开始征服当前地牢楼层。\n伊莱德莱姆努尔只会为火炬点燃时进行的击杀提供虔诚值。\n\n那些已经赢得伊莱德莱姆努尔一些好感的人将被赐予临时的亡灵仆从来帮助\n开始他们的征服，经验丰富且特别虔诚的人将获得更强大的仆从。\n\n伊莱德莱姆努尔不提供第二次机会——当你离开当前楼层时火炬将熄灭，\n且每层只能点燃一次，永不再来。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Raises the Black Torch aloft and calls upon Yredelemnul to light it aflame,\nmarking the beginning of your attempt to conquer the current level of the\ndungeon. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"为一位被击败的使徒涂抹灰烬和木炭，接纳其成为永久的追随者。\n这位使徒会跟随你穿梭各楼层、共赴任何险境，甘愿为事业和同胞献出生命。\n\n若这位使徒牺牲，比欧弗终将在你获得足够虔诚值后使其复活。\n杀死所有可能曾参与杀害这位使徒的敌人，令比欧弗满意，便能大大加快这一过程。\n\n你最多可以同时带领3位追随者，但可自由遣散原有追随者，邀请新成员加入。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Anoints a defeated apostle, and welcomes them as a permanent follower. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"与毁灭者签订血之契约，暂时赋予你巨大的力量，但代价危险。\n\n在契约缔结的那一刻，一场巨大的天谴爆炸将包围你，你将变身为恶魔化身，\n获得恶魔抗性、不可动摇的意志、击杀时双倍治疗效果，并将所有受到的\n伤害减少1/3。你还会根据使用此能力时的受伤程度获得额外的输出伤害加成。\n\n当你的变身结束时，你将被拖入血肉熔炉，被迫与一波波恶魔战斗，\n直到马科列布认为你的债务已偿清。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/ability.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Invokes a blood pact with the Destroyer, temporarily granting you enormous power\nat a dangerous price.\n\nAt the moment the pact is sealed, a massive explosion of damnation will surround\nyou, and you will transform into a demonic avatar, granting you demonic\nresistances, invulnerable will, doubled healing from kills, and reducing all\ndamage you take by 1/3. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"这个生物的碎裂武器已完全充能，下一次攻击会更精准、伤害大幅提高，\n劈砍范围也会扩大。如果它移动了，此效果将消失。","current_chinese_name":"ready to sunder monstatus"},"current_english":{"english_description":"This creature's Sundering weapon is fully charged and its next attack will be\nmore accurate, inflict greatly increased damage, and cleave with increased range.\nThis effect will be lost if it moves.","english_source_name":"ready to sunder monstatus"},"fact_sha256":"af60f1f8ca7439ee6815d13a025287c5f6eaca4fac11c309caa6e6bd4d6fb68a","identity":"monster_status:ready to sunder monstatus","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"monster_status","chinese_description":"这个生物的碎裂武器已完全充能，下一次攻击会更精准、伤害大幅提高，\n劈砍范围也会扩大。如果它移动了，此效果将消失。","current_chinese_name":"ready to sunder monstatus","description_key":"ready to sunder monstatus","english_description":"This creature's Sundering weapon is fully charged and its next attack will be\nmore accurate, inflict greatly increased damage, and cleave with increased range.\nThis effect will be lost if it moves.","english_source_name":"ready to sunder monstatus","identity":"monster_status:ready to sunder monstatus","lifecycle":"current","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monstatus.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"回补 #241：调整伤害语序，保留完全充能、下一击更精准、增伤、扩大劈砍范围和移动后失效；沿用稳定版“崩裂”名称。","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至最大生命值的50%以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","current_chinese_name":"颂礼者印记","display_strings[0].chinese":"颂礼者印记","display_strings[1].chinese":"你携带着颂礼者印记。","display_strings[2].chinese":"你的苦难将以鲜血偿还。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"Mark of the Celebrant","display_strings[1].english":"You bear the Mark of the Celebrant.","display_strings[2].english":"Your suffering will be repaid in blood.","english_description":"Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","current_chinese_name":"处决印记","display_strings[0].chinese":"处决印记","display_strings[1].chinese":"你携带着处决印记。","display_strings[2].chinese":"杀戮在你灵魂中扎下了根。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"Mark of Execution","display_strings[1].english":"You bear the Mark of Execution.","display_strings[2].english":"Murder takes root in your soul.","english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你发生传送时，都有概率将另一只怪物一同拉到你的新位置。\n短距离传送只会拉走你原位置视野内的怪物，长距离传送则可能拉来本层任何地方的怪物。\n\n这种经历会使怪物略感迷乱，被拉来后无法立即行动。","current_chinese_name":"空间纠缠","display_strings[0].chinese":"空间纠缠","display_strings[1].chinese":"当你位移时，有时会将一个怪物一起拉过去。","display_strings[2].chinese":"你感到周围的空间开始纠结在一起。","display_strings[3].chinese":"你感到空间从你身上解开了纠缠。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"spatial entanglement","display_strings[1].english":"When you translocate, a monster is sometimes pulled along with you.","display_strings[2].english":"You feel space start to knot itself around you.","display_strings[3].english":"You feel space untangle itself from you.","english_description":"Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled\nalong to your new location. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"在你的道路上黑暗会遁形，从而扩大了视野和远程攻击范围（+1视线），\n但也使得你能从更远的地方被发现并成为潜在目标。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"The darkness flees at your approach, allowing an extended range of vision and\nranged attack (+1 line of sight), but also allowing you to be seen and\npotentially targeted from further away.","english_source_name":"+los mutation"},"fact_sha256":"ce86f82c9f81e61425805b53f1e9fc551c71f66b13043f3c7f7b3bdcf44b35d7","identity":"mutation_description:+los mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"在你的道路上黑暗会遁形，从而扩大了视野和远程攻击范围（+1视线），\n但也使得你能从更远的地方被发现并成为潜在目标。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"+los mutation","english_description":"The darkness flees at your approach, allowing an extended range of vision and\nranged attack (+1 line of sight), but also allowing you to be seen and\npotentially targeted from further away.","english_source_name":"+los mutation","identity":"mutation_description:+los mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你用偷袭杀死有血液的活物时，它可能会复生并作为吸血鬼仆从为你效力。\n仆从保留生前的全部能力，但属于亡灵，并会获得吸血鬼啃咬攻击，\n且对沉睡敌人造成更高近战伤害。会施法的仆从还会学会吸血鬼汲取法术。\n\n你只能在没有仆从时创造一个；它会在短时间后不可避免地化为尘土。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you kill a living monster with a stab attack, they may rise again to serve\nyou as a vampiric thrall. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你没有实体，而是通过附身物品与世界互动。因此，你可以用任意组合“装备”最多 6 件\n靴子、手套、斗篷或头盔，但身体护甲太大，无法以这种方式有效操纵。\n\n更高等级时，你甚至能让所附身的护甲短暂地独立出击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting\nobjects. This allows you to 'equip' up to 6 boots, gloves, cloaks, or helmets in\nany combination, but body armour is too large for you to usefully manipulate in\nthis fashion.\n\nAt higher levels, you can even send the armour you are haunting out to attack\nenemies independently for short periods of time.","english_source_name":"formless mutation"},"fact_sha256":"0826d68b5f4f1fdc722679fe84c549d8e5ade43bcd6b1c55767ee3d471e78aab","identity":"mutation_description:formless mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你没有实体，而是通过附身物品与世界互动。因此，你可以用任意组合“装备”最多 6 件\n靴子、手套、斗篷或头盔，但身体护甲太大，无法以这种方式有效操纵。\n\n更高等级时，你甚至能让所附身的护甲短暂地独立出击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"formless mutation","english_description":"You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting\nobjects. This allows you to 'equip' up to 6 boots, gloves, cloaks, or helmets in\nany combination, but body armour is too large for you to usefully manipulate in\nthis fashion.\n\nAt higher levels, you can even send the armour you are haunting out to attack\nenemies independently for short periods of time.","english_source_name":"formless mutation","identity":"mutation_description:formless mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的身体笼罩着污秽之焰。敌人更难命中你，你的潜行也大幅增强。\n近战攻击你的敌人有时会被污秽之焰灼烧；亡灵和恶魔受到的伤害较少，\n神圣生物和善神信徒受到的伤害较多。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your body is shadowed by foul flame. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你有两对手臂，可以一对持握双手武器、另一对持盾，还能额外穿戴一双手套。\n你甚至可以挥舞巨棒等极其巨大的武器，不过这需要两对手臂共同持握。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have two pairs of two arms, allowing you to wield two-handed weapons with\none pair and a shield with the other, as well as wear a second pair of gloves.\nYou can even wield extremely large weapons like giant clubs, though this takes\nboth arm-pairs.","english_source_name":"four strong arms mutation"},"fact_sha256":"bc800507e9a8d9bc7f4bf8113a2dcd1b54edbaf94f351e61b2d3240df8bf55d1","identity":"mutation_description:four strong arms mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你有两对手臂，可以一对持握双手武器、另一对持盾，还能额外穿戴一双手套。\n你甚至可以挥舞巨棒等极其巨大的武器，不过这需要两对手臂共同持握。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"four strong arms mutation","english_description":"You have two pairs of two arms, allowing you to wield two-handed weapons with\none pair and a shield with the other, as well as wear a second pair of gloves.\nYou can even wield extremely large weapons like giant clubs, though this takes\nboth arm-pairs.","english_source_name":"four strong arms mutation","identity":"mutation_description:four strong arms mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你受到寒冷伤害时，都有一定概率陷入冰封，短时间内降低移动速度。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you are exposed to cold damage, you have a chance to become Frozen,\nlowering your movement speed for a short while.","english_source_name":"freeze response mutation"},"fact_sha256":"a9882789d109f266018cf099930ebcc7816bfa3db6e44e84ec67a7ff262eb993","identity":"mutation_description:freeze response mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你受到寒冷伤害时，都有一定概率陷入冰封，短时间内降低移动速度。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"freeze response mutation","english_description":"Whenever you are exposed to cold damage, you have a chance to become Frozen,\nlowering your movement speed for a short while.","english_source_name":"freeze response mutation","identity":"mutation_description:freeze response mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你免疫冰汽云。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You are immune to freezing clouds.","english_source_name":"freezing cloud immunity mutation"},"fact_sha256":"88a25f0e34883a1a5ea69a97bf19eff66a2d2495602e14834b9ee9503a2df376","identity":"mutation_description:freezing cloud immunity mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你免疫冰汽云。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"freezing cloud immunity mutation","english_description":"You are immune to freezing clouds.","english_source_name":"freezing cloud immunity mutation","identity":"mutation_description:freezing cloud immunity mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的呼吸散发出刺骨寒意，在战斗时将附近墙壁冻实。\n\n每当你攻击时，目标或你自己相邻的一面随机墙壁会变得严寒。\n严寒墙壁每回合会伤害与其相邻的敌人；敌人周围的严寒墙壁达到最大数量时，\n伤害最高可翻倍。此伤害随变形术技能提高。\n\n如果你停止攻击，墙壁会迅速融化。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your breath radiates an intense chill which freezes nearby walls solid as you\nfight.\n\nWhenever you attack, you turn a random wall adjacent to your target or yourself\nfrigid. Frigid walls deal damage to any enemies adjacent to them each turn - up\nto twice as much when an enemy is adjacent to as many as possible. This damage\nincreases with your shapeshifting skill.\n\nThe walls will rapidly melt again if you stop attacking.","english_source_name":"frigid aura mutation"},"fact_sha256":"78a9eb7bf1ee8ee055e6d43b9c080f649a0ac0dffd52d463a73c76eed15ef7b3","identity":"mutation_description:frigid aura mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的呼吸散发出刺骨寒意，在战斗时将附近墙壁冻实。\n\n每当你攻击时，目标或你自己相邻的一面随机墙壁会变得严寒。\n严寒墙壁每回合会伤害与其相邻的敌人；敌人周围的严寒墙壁达到最大数量时，\n伤害最高可翻倍。此伤害随变形术技能提高。\n\n如果你停止攻击，墙壁会迅速融化。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"frigid aura mutation","english_description":"Your breath radiates an intense chill which freezes nearby walls solid as you\nfight.\n\nWhenever you attack, you turn a random wall adjacent to your target or yourself\nfrigid. Frigid walls deal damage to any enemies adjacent to them each turn - up\nto twice as much when an enemy is adjacent to as many as possible. This damage\nincreases with your shapeshifting skill.\n\nThe walls will rapidly melt again if you stop attacking.","english_source_name":"frigid aura mutation","identity":"mutation_description:frigid aura mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你异常强健的双腿让你可以用 <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 在眨眼间跳过短距离，\n但步行速度低于平均水平。\n\n此变异的第二级能让你跳得更远。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an\neye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is\nbelow average.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.","english_source_name":"frog-like legs mutation"},"fact_sha256":"21d242990b0e2cf439be493b6df85555d40cb762a54a14df4a04d41e0035b16a","identity":"mutation_description:frog-like legs mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你异常强健的双腿让你可以用 <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 在眨眼间跳过短距离，\n但步行速度低于平均水平。\n\n此变异的第二级能让你跳得更远。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"frog-like legs mutation","english_description":"Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an\neye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is\nbelow average.\n\nThe second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.","english_source_name":"frog-like legs mutation","identity":"mutation_description:frog-like legs mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或更低时，愤怒的蜜蜂就会从你体内蜂拥而出，保护你。\n\n在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less, angry bees will swarm\nout of your body to defend you.\n\nThis effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.","english_source_name":"hive swarm mutation"},"fact_sha256":"12564d5b9d5f1af6f7ee5c6aaa58dd837d04ea46ac42c8e66776b4786c750cb3","identity":"mutation_description:hive swarm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或更低时，愤怒的蜜蜂就会从你体内蜂拥而出，保护你。\n\n在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"hive swarm mutation","english_description":"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less, angry bees will swarm\nout of your body to defend you.\n\nThis effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.","english_source_name":"hive swarm mutation","identity":"mutation_description:hive swarm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep (finding resolved, both languages now aligned with the implementation): the initial review flagged that the ZH body omitted the numeric trigger and said only 受到严重伤害, while ouch.cc::_maybe_hive_swarm returns early when hp * 2 > hp_max, i.e. it triggers at 50% or less. The frozen #211 EN correction (less than 50% -> 50% or less) had been missed by the stable backport, so at that time the EN text, the ZH text and the code disagreed (EN < vs implementation <=). Both sides have now been read back from the current files: mutations.txt says \"Whenever an injury reduces your health to 50% or less\" and mutations.txt (zh) says 每当受伤使你的生命值降至上限的50%或以下时 with the 在你的生命值完全恢复之前，此效果不会再次触发 retrigger sentence. Threshold and retrigger condition now match the code, so the Needs Fix is closed.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你第一次看到某只怪物时，它可能会被魔法拉向你。\n这有概率惊醒沉睡的怪物，但它们不一定会察觉你的位置。\n这个变异达到第二级后，触发概率会提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"The first time you see a monster, it may be magically pulled toward you.
