{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你无法从书本习得法术。取而代之的是，随着你经验的增加，\n越来越高级的法术从你炽热的内心中涌现。\n这些法术是不可预知的，且不受你皈依的神影响。\n你无法训练特定的法术流派——要么同时都进行训练，要么一个都不进行训练。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You cannot learn spells from books. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的鳞片与厚重铁层融合，坚韧程度如同一套护甲（AC +5）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your scales are fused with a thick layer of iron, giving them resilience akin to\na suit of armour (+5 AC).","english_source_name":"iron-fused scales mutation"},"fact_sha256":"6e7e66c3971a2dd33324602427188581ac04d1fbce43570c51c31eaa7de12aa3","identity":"mutation_description:iron-fused scales mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的鳞片与厚重铁层融合，坚韧程度如同一套护甲（AC +5）。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"iron-fused scales mutation","english_description":"Your scales are fused with a thick layer of iron, giving them resilience akin to\na suit of armour (+5 AC).","english_source_name":"iron-fused scales mutation","identity":"mutation_description:iron-fused scales mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 60% 或以下时，触须会反射性地尝试石化你周围 3 格内\n所有中毒的敌人。此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发，成功率随变形术技能提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When your health drops to 60% of your max HP or less, your tendrils reflexively\nattempt to petrify all poisoned enemies within 3 tiles of you.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal and its success chance\nimproves with your Shapeshifting skill.","english_source_name":"lithotoxin mutation"},"fact_sha256":"3ee19f86f2774f4a603c6b21267e658fceaf75d845b3ac3b8ab0720e9f3e2962","identity":"mutation_description:lithotoxin mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你的生命值降至上限的 60% 或以下时，触须会反射性地尝试石化你周围 3 格内\n所有中毒的敌人。此效果在你完全恢复前无法再次触发，成功率随变形术技能提高。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"lithotoxin mutation","english_description":"When your health drops to 60% of your max HP or less, your tendrils reflexively\nattempt to petrify all poisoned enemies within 3 tiles of you.\n\nThis effect cannot activate again until you fully heal and its success chance\nimproves with your Shapeshifting skill.","english_source_name":"lithotoxin mutation","identity":"mutation_description:lithotoxin mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你有一种不可思议的直觉，能发现别人可能当作凡品忽略的物品的隐藏属性。\n每当你第一次遇到地上的新物品时，都有极小概率发现它其实是神器。\n这个变异每升一级都会提高该概率。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have an uncanny knack for uncovering hidden properties of items other people\nmight ignore as mundane. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你受到伤害时，一些伤害会转而消耗你的法力储备。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you are harmed, some damage is redirected to deplete your magic reserves\ninstead.","english_source_name":"magic shield mutation"},"fact_sha256":"3f9762e572ae4da7e275100583167f991b7262ae0142007beeba454727cbe5a8","identity":"mutation_description:magic shield mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你受到伤害时，一些伤害会转而消耗你的法力储备。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"magic shield mutation","english_description":"When you are harmed, some damage is redirected to deplete your magic reserves\ninstead.","english_source_name":"magic shield mutation","identity":"mutation_description:magic shield mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill\nan enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a\nmaelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack\nwhenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy\nattack.\n\nYou have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if\nyou spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the\ndemonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.","english_source_name":"mark of execution mutation"},"fact_sha256":"91a6a5e88f629b1b54027fb3d97c5d018503c84b5cc1c68a43f652502e9c98c8","identity":"mutation_description:mark of execution mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"一个谋杀之恶魔化身潜伏在你的灵魂中。每当你用近战击杀一个敌人时，\n有很小概率它会醒来并显现为包围你的镰刀刀锋漩涡。这些刀锋会在你\n攻击时一起攻击，并在你成功闪避敌人攻击时反击。\n\n附身期间，你可以快速冲锋接近敌人；但若有超过短暂片刻未进行攻击，\n恶魔存在就会再次在你体内沉睡。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of execution mutation","english_description":"A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill\nan enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a\nmaelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack\nwhenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy\nattack.\n\nYou have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if\nyou spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the\ndemonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.","english_source_name":"mark of execution mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of execution mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation"},"fact_sha256":"91825f6d2fceb1c1907a69768c22aba6c0b7bde730d30148c8560d9727dee3c8","identity":"mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"当你击杀敌人时，它们有很小概率爆炸为一阵猛烈的血雨，对相邻的敌人造成\n与受害者最大生命值成比例的伤害。\n\n死于这种爆炸的敌人自身也总是会爆炸。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","english_description":"When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of\ngore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health.\n\nEnemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.","english_source_name":"mark of haemoclasm mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of haemoclasm mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至最大生命值的50%以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. You will fire at\nleast one arrow for every valid target, but may fire additional ones if few are\npresent. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will\nalways bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them.\n\nAfter performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has\nfully recovered.","english_source_name":"mark of the celebrant mutation"},"fact_sha256":"bed2ed62bc30b6ecef0cb2b91442bbf55c65dfe25d373260445626be12f61e0c","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the celebrant mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至最大生命值的50%以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the celebrant mutation","english_description":"Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will\nalways bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them.\n\nAfter performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has\nfully recovered.","english_source_name":"mark of the celebrant mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the celebrant mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation"},"fact_sha256":"e7cc727bf3cbcdf4d04245a3f59567a28170bec6a2dded3b283671e46337fddd","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"赋予你杀戮化身能力，允许你在短时间内变身为一个强大的恶魔化身，\n大幅提升攻击和防御，代价是之后被拖入血肉熔炉并被迫为自由而战。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"mark of the fanatic mutation","english_description":"Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a\npowerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short\nperiod of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh\nafterward and made to fight for your freedom.","english_source_name":"mark of the fanatic mutation","identity":"mutation_description:mark of the fanatic mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的地狱仆从能力被替换为地狱军团，允许你随时间召唤一小支恶魔军队。\n虽然个体存活短暂，但只要状态持续，它们的数量无穷无尽，\n并且永远不会对你敌对。\n\n你也可以通过你召唤的盟友释放马科列布的毁灭而不伤害它们。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Infernal Legion, allowing you to\ncall in a small army of demons over time. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的地狱仆从持续时间更长，在非常高的祈神技能下你甚至可以\n召唤更强大的仆从（以额外的虔诚值为代价）。当你杀死敌人时，\n一个随机仆从可能获得以下之一：加速、强效、再生或聪慧。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your Infernal Servants have a longer duration, and you can summon even stronger\nones at very high Invocations (at the cost of additional piety). {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"当你身受重伤且孤身一人时，收割者可能会来索命。它们免疫非相邻来源的一切伤害；\n若你的经验等级低于 14，它们还会行动缓慢。经验等级更高时，可能同时出现多个收割者。\n\n此灾祸解除时，以这种方式召唤的所有收割者都会立即消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"When you are badly injured and alone, a reaper may come to claim you. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每过三级，你将获得额外的生命。\n如果你被杀的时候还有一条命，你会在当前楼层的其他地方重新出现。\n即使你达到了最高的经验等级，你也可以继续获得额外的生命，\n但最多只能有两条额外生命。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Every third experience level, you gain an extra life. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的脚变成一条长长的蛇状尾巴，使你能在水中保持稳定，\n但移动速度会比大多数物种慢得多。这个变异达到第二级，\n你在近战时可以用尾巴束缚敌人。你的尾巴一次只能束缚一个敌人，\n在这个变异等级，每次攻击都会尝试开始或再次进行束缚。\n成功率主要取决于敏捷、格斗技能和任何杀戮加成。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You have a long, snake-like tail in place of feet. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你在休息时无法恢复健康，也无法获得提升恢复速度的魔法效果。\n至于提升生命力的手段，像药水和虔诚的祈祷仍能治疗你，\n某些神圣祈祷能力可以短暂赋予你自愈的能力。\n作为补偿，你可以通过<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> 键治疗自己，\n但代价是要永久地失去一些法力。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the\neffects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. Sources of HP gain\nsuch as potions and religious invocations will still heal you, and certain\ndivine invocations can temporarily grant you the ability to regenerate.\nTo compensate, you are able to heal yourself via the\n<input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> key, at the cost of permanent MP.","english_source_name":"no regeneration mutation","identity":"mutation_description:no regeneration mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"只要没有持握双手武器，也没有装备盾牌或魔法球，你就可以在副手持握一件单手武器。\n主手攻击后会追加一次副手攻击，攻击延迟由两件武器的平均值决定。\n远程武器只能追击远程武器的攻击，近战武器也同样只能追击近战攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a\ntwo-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. Ranged weapons can only follow attacks by ranged\nweapons, and likewise melee weapons.","english_source_name":"off-hand wielding mutation"},"fact_sha256":"e252a572ff289ee30508d0405c7dfa5abd043c0ec135ec264a6de55a0cd15851","identity":"mutation_description:off-hand wielding mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"只要没有持握双手武器，也没有装备盾牌或魔法球，你就可以在副手持握一件单手武器。\n主手攻击后会追加一次副手攻击，攻击延迟由两件武器的平均值决定。\n远程武器只能追击远程武器的攻击，近战武器也同样只能追击近战攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"off-hand wielding mutation","english_description":"You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a\ntwo-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你首次发现一个怪物时，它有概率被悖论触碰，\n从而能将多重攻击作为天生能力使用，并在使用后有小概率随机闪烁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you first spot a monster, it has a chance to become Touched by Paradox,\ngiving it the ability to use Manifold Assault as a natural ability (and a small\nchance to blink randomly after doing so).","english_source_name":"paradox bane"},"fact_sha256":"19c82121fc99d0ee840bc83f5107d462a10d644cb8c1f209bfd9cb71b9f6fdc6","identity":"mutation_description:paradox bane","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你首次发现一个怪物时，它有概率被悖论触碰，\n从而能将多重攻击作为天生能力使用，并在使用后有小概率随机闪烁。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"paradox bane","english_description":"Whenever you first spot a monster, it has a chance to become Touched by Paradox,\ngiving it the ability to use Manifold Assault as a natural ability (and a small\nchance to blink randomly after doing so).","english_source_name":"paradox bane","identity":"mutation_description:paradox bane","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你发生传送时，都有概率将另一只怪物一同拉到你的新位置。\n短距离传送只会拉走你原位置视野内的怪物，长距离传送则可能拉来本层任何地方的怪物。\n\n这种经历会使怪物略感迷乱，被拉来后无法立即行动。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled\nalong to your new location. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的胶状身体有八个触手，可以帮助你在浅水或深水中移动，并能在近战时束缚敌人。\n每只触手都可以戴上戒指，但你需要四只触手用来移动，根据武器的大小，\n两只或四只触手可以拿一把武器，两只触手可以拿一面盾牌。\n\n当你近战时，你的触手会尝试束缚敌人。（你无法束缚比你大的怪物。）\n顺便一提，每当你近战攻击时，你有三分之二的机会发动破坏性的“挤压”攻击。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow\nor deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in\nmelee. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你散播不幸时，与生者领域的联系会变强。\n\n每当你或盟友对附近敌人施加新的负面状态（中毒除外）时，你的护甲等级会暂时提高。\n受影响的不同敌人越多，加成越高；若不继续施加新的不幸，加成会随时间衰减。\n\n以你当前的经验等级，此方式最多可获得\n{{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} 点护甲等级。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread\nmisfortune.\n\nWhenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby\nenemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"你的身体由能灵活变形的元素水构成，可以从数格外发动近战攻击，\n包括各种辅助攻击。\n\n偷袭所需的精确动作仍只能在与目标相邻时完成；无论从哪里攻击，\n斧头也只能顺劈到与你相邻的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you\nto reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary\nattacks of all sorts.\n\nThe precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're\nadjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you,\nregardless of where you strike.","english_source_name":"water reaching mutation"},"fact_sha256":"5160ad2161065e820dc008e4d5208a93f725f9852ab663cf7e38bf975c71f838","identity":"mutation_description:water reaching mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"你的身体由能灵活变形的元素水构成，可以从数格外发动近战攻击，\n包括各种辅助攻击。\n\n偷袭所需的精确动作仍只能在与目标相邻时完成；无论从哪里攻击，\n斧头也只能顺劈到与你相邻的敌人。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"water reaching mutation","english_description":"Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you\nto reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary\nattacks of all sorts.\n\nThe precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're\nadjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you,\nregardless of where you strike.","english_source_name":"water reaching mutation","identity":"mutation_description:water reaching mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation"},"fact_sha256":"2f986443b236e1358f6d5c36fa682352066bf3ab3f0a4d376527a6ec81d6af2f","identity":"mutation_description:werefury mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","production_facts":{"category":"mutation_description","chinese_description":"每当你用近战攻击杀死敌人时，会获得随变形术技能提高的临时杀戮加成。\n\n此加成最多叠加至 +12；只要你继续发动近战攻击，就不会消失。","chinese_source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/mutations.txt","description_key":"werefury mutation","english_description":"Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying\nbonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill.\n\nThis bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to\nperform melee attacks.","english_source_name":"werefury mutation","identity":"mutation_description:werefury mutation","lifecycle":"static-body","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/mutations.txt"},"reviewer_rationale":"keep: mutation name/description pair matches EN mechanics, level text and numeric effects; no placeholder or terminology drift found.","terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"空气系包含直接用风造成伤害的法术，也包含轰鸣而强大的闪电咒法。\n其中也有一些实用法术，例如呼唤风来辅助移动，或用妖术系法术阻止周围区域的大多数魔法。\n\n提升空气系技能会提升空气系法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个魔法流派，\n对于这类法术，法术的成功率和法术威力由这些流派的技能平均值决定。","current_chinese_name":"空气系","titles[0].chinese":"阵风","titles[1].chinese":"和风术士","titles[2].chinese":"风暴召唤者","titles[3].chinese":"云中法师","titles[4].chinese":"天象师"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Air Magic provides spells to deal damage directly with the wind, as well as\nnoisy but powerful lightning Conjurations. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"咒法系魔法是关注战斗的魔法流派，\n旨在塑造出一团短暂存在的物质并将其推向敌人以造成伤害。\n提升咒法系技能通常会增加这类法术的伤害和命中率，有时也会增加其射程或影响范围。\n\n提升咒法系技能会提升咒法系法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个魔法流派，\n对于这类法术，法术的成功率和法术威力由这些流派的技能平均值决定。","current_chinese_name":"咒法系","titles[0].chinese":"咒法师","titles[1].chinese":"毁灭者","titles[2].chinese":"毁灭者","titles[3].chinese":"破灭者","titles[4].chinese":"湮灭者"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Conjurations are battle oriented spells, which often work by conjuring up a\nchunk of short-lived matter and propelling it towards the victim to deal direct\ndamage. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"妖术系法术会对周围的事物施加各种魔法效果。\n虽然不会直接造成伤害，但足以让中招的敌人失去战斗力；\n不过，这些法术通常需要击垮敌人的意志力才能生效。\n提升妖术系技能有助于做到这一点。\n\n提升妖术系技能会提升妖术系法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个魔法流派，\n对于这类法术，法术的成功率和法术威力由这些流派的技能平均值决定。","current_chinese_name":"妖术系","titles[0].chinese":"恼怒","titles[1].chinese":"灾星","titles[2].chinese":"蛊惑者","titles[3].chinese":"诅咒师","titles[4].chinese":"咒缚者"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Hexes try to bestow various enchantments on nearby things. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"召唤系魔法旨在从另一个现实位面召唤生物来暂时帮助你。\n提升召唤系技能会根据具体法术带来一系列效果，例如延长持续时间或召来更强大的盟友。\n需要注意的是，召唤生物不会留下尸体；击杀它们不会获得经验值，它们的装备也会随之消散。\n\n提升召唤系技能会提升召唤系法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个魔法流派，\n对于这类法术，法术的成功率和法术威力由这些流派的技能平均值决定。","current_chinese_name":"召唤系","titles[0].chinese":"呼唤者","titles[1].chinese":"召唤师","titles[2].chinese":"召集者","titles[3].chinese":"缚界者","titles[4].chinese":"撕裂位面者"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Summonings deals with summoning creatures from another plane of reality to\ntemporarily aid you.
